verdict.rationale: Apify says it supports Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium and its own Crawlee browser-automation library, so a developer can write Actors that click and fill forms. SessionPool documents cookie and session handling, which is relevant to keeping logged-in state. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents continuing to interact with an already-scraped page or getting through login walls; it is only implied by the supported automation libraries. Missing for 10: documented interactive or stateful page-session control after scraping, a login and form-filling guide or example, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
